dataset: Mendeley 40_70mm pre-registered 8-image test split (9,208 GT instances)
method: local bbox masks; instance match IoU>=0.5; relation graph from predicted/GT masks; touching/near->contact; max_instances=3000
limitations: Public COCO polygons; human-review/SAM-assist status unverified.
GT relation edges derived from GT masks, not independent human relation labels.
Greedy IoU matching; touching/near collapsed to contact.
SAM2 fixed 1008 tiling; no real ore/hardware.
